The '''Myrenia system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Myrenia]]''.<ref name="FarOrbit">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=The Capture of Coh Veshiv}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Myrenia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
